hardRequirement: Use included Cloudflare capacity without creating any additional usage-based charge.

ownerUsageSnapshot.source: Cloudflare Billing > Billable Usage; values supplied by the account owner

cloudflareWorkersBuildMinutes.lockReason: The owner-supplied 2026-08-02 snapshot already contains 5,470 billable build minutes. No further Cloudflare Workers Build may be triggered in this billing period.

releaseRules.productionAuthority: manual GitHub Actions controlled production workflow using Wrangler

utilizationStrategy.developmentBuilds: Run locally or in GitHub Actions so routine commits do not consume Cloudflare Workers Build minutes.
utilizationStrategy.productionBuilds: Batch proven changes into a manual canonical release; do not rebuild unchanged output.
utilizationStrategy.workersRuntime: Use normally with static caching and abuse controls; current CPU and request usage are well below included allowances.
utilizationStrategy.d1: Use indexed, bounded queries and idempotent writes; current read, write and storage usage are well below included allowances.
utilizationStrategy.kv: Use cache-friendly reads and avoid write-on-read counters; current operation and storage usage are well below included allowances.

unlockConditions: A new Cloudflare billing period is visible in the account dashboard.
Workers Builds total and billable usage have been checked within the previous 24 hours.
Billable usage for every metered Cloudflare product is zero.
The Worker is disconnected from Cloudflare Git builds and non-production branch builds are disabled.
The snapshot in this policy and the protected GitHub usage variables are updated by the owner.
operatingPrinciple: Improve the site aggressively off-cloud, release deliberately, and fail closed before any uncertain or billable Cloudflare operation.
